headline: Caught one more crash in the intro-followup surface + tied up paths and apply-time handlers from the prior round.

items.prompt_template: Second-round verification caught one more crash in the intro-followup card. The action buttons were fixed, but the description text still contained a phrase that trips my internal jargon scanner — so the card would crash with a different error. Fixed.

I added the apply-time handler documentation for the three intro-followup action buttons from the prior update — they were recognized by the renderer but the dispatch logic for what happens on click wasn't documented. Every button now has a documented path so the intro-followup state persists correctly across pulses.
Internal tidying — nothing changes for you.
